claim: Johann Sebastian Bach worked for church authorities in Leipzig and, earlier in his career, for aristocratic employers such as the Margrave of Brandenburg, to whom he dedicated a set of six concertos in 1721.
problem: The Margrave of Brandenburg (Christian Ludwig) was never Bach's employer. At the time of the 1721 dedication, Bach was employed by Prince Leopold of Anhalt-Köthen. The six Brandenburg Concertos were an unsolicited gift/job application sent hoping to win the Margrave's patronage; the Margrave never took Bach into his service, and the scores were found unused in his library after his death in 1734. Listing the Margrave as an example of Bach's 'aristocratic employers' states an employment relationship that did not exist.
correction: Rephrase to something like: '...and, earlier in his career, for aristocratic patrons such as Prince Leopold of Anhalt-Köthen. In 1721 Bach also sent a set of six concertos to the Margrave of Brandenburg hoping to secure his patronage, though the Margrave never employed him or had the works performed.'

claim: Listen — Mozart - Flute Concerto No. 1 in D major, K. 314
problem: Mozart's Flute Concerto No. 1 is in G major, K. 313. The work in D major, K. 314 (an arrangement of his Oboe Concerto in C major) is Flute Concerto No. 2. This caption misidentifies the work by number, and even contradicts the embedded video's own title, which correctly reads 'Flute concerto No 2 D major, K 314'. A student could learn the wrong number/key pairing for a named work.
correction: Change the caption to 'Listen — Mozart - Flute Concerto No. 2 in D major, K. 314'.

claim: Listen — Mozart - Flute Concerto in D major, K. 314, first movement
problem: The embedded video is explicitly titled 'Mozart: Flute Concerto in D major K314, 3rd movement (with my own cadenzas)', i.e. the rondo finale, not the first movement. The caption mislabels which movement students are hearing, which matters in a lesson whose whole method is listening for movement-specific structural features (e.g. cadenza placement within a movement, sonata-form first movement vs rondo finale).
correction: Change the caption to 'Listen — Mozart - Flute Concerto in D major, K. 314, third movement (rondo finale)'.
